ruling.recommended_action: Hand the file to a human safety reviewer: take the rider's dangerous-driving account (speeding, hard braking, shoulder overtaking) and the driver's [threat]-tagged statement at F5; check for telematics/speed-band or in-vehicle evidence for the 08:36–08:52 window, and remind the driver of Ryde's Code of Conduct via RydeHELP. No fare adjustment.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety-typed dispute (rider alleges speeding, hard braking, shoulder overtaking) plus a [threat]-tagged statement in the file. No automated ruling; human safety review required.

rejected_claims.reason: Rejected: SAFE-1 is triggered by the presence of abuse in the record regardless of who filed the complaint, and the driver's own statement at F5 ('the rider is stupid') is a personal attack on this rider, i.e. abuse directed at the passenger by the driver [F5][SAFE-1].

Not adopted as a ground for any relief: F6 (661-day account, 4.6 rating, 0 disputes/0 upheld in 90 d) is a profile fact and cannot decide the case; the rider's good faith does not substitute for the missing speed/braking evidence, and no monetary remedy follows [F6][SAFE-1].

Withdrawn by the rider advocate and independently unsupported: SAFE-2 escalation is not needed here (SAFE-1 already governs), and no account action arises because F7 shows 0 prior upheld disputes, so RD-6's 'repeated' precondition is unmet [F7][RD-6][SAFE-2].

Rejected as a bar to escalation: even without an accident/injury record, the rider's account is a dangerous-driving allegation within the safety-event scope, and F5 independently engages SAFE-1, so escalation is not excluded [F5][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

Correct as to routing but irrelevant to the disposition: F1 shows no off-route segment and -0.1 km versus optimal, so no RD-1/RD-2 detour refund arises, yet routing facts cannot resolve a safety allegation [F1][RD-1][SAFE-1].

Rejected as a rebuttal of the safety allegation: F2 records only total duration (16.1 min vs 16 min), which says nothing about instantaneous speed or braking, so it does not disprove the rider's account [F2][SAFE-1].
Not applied: RD-6 requires an established case plus a prior upheld dispute in 90 days; F7 shows 0 disputes and 0 upheld, so no flag_account follows from this record [F7][RD-6].
